extracted.name: Butterscotch Bars
ingredient_lines: 3/4 cups pecan, walnuts, or cashew nuts
instruction_lines: Mix ingredients. Start with dry ingredients. Mix 2 eggs, butter, glucose syrup, vanilla and nuts.
TIP: Always pour in the wet ones to the dry ingredients and don’t over mix it if you want to maintain the fluffiness.
For glucose syrup, wet your hands first and use your wet hands to transfer syrup to the batter.
